name: piwi-tui
description: A playful, safe, full-featured pi.dev TUI extension package.
comment: Runtime dependencies are only for wiki document extraction. Plain md/markdown/txt/text/csv/tsv/json/log/rst needs none. For local-path installs, run `bun install` to extract pdf/docx/pptx/xlsx/odt/odp/ods. Install with `pi install ./TUI` or `-l` for one project.
